title: First Sprout
description: Welcome to the lab. Your first task is simple: plant your first seed and give it a name. This marks the beginning of your journey.

title: Water of Life
description: Hydration is key. Log your water intake for the day in the Journal. Your plants are thirsty, and so are you.

title: The Daily Log
description: Consistency builds empires. Create your first Journal Entry. Write about your goals for this week.

title: Weed Patrol
description: A wild Toxic Briar has appeared! Play the Mini Game and tap 10 bad habits to clear the garden.

title: Knowledge Seeker
description: Read one article about 'Rare Plant Care' in the Home tab. Knowledge allows your garden to flourish.

title: Test Your Mettle
description: Complete the 'Botany Basics' test with a 100% score. Prove you are worthy of the Green Thumb title.

title: Neon Dreams
description: Unlock the Neon Ivy plant. It requires you to reach a streak of 3 days. Can you keep the lights on?

title: Master Gardener
description: Level up your Lumina Sprout to its maximum stage (Level 3). This requires dedication and time.

title: Social Butterfly
description: Check the Global Statistics in the Stats tab. How does your garden compare to the worldwide laboratory?

title: Hidden Gem
description: Unlock the Crystal Succulent by writing 5 honest journal entries. Truth is the best fertilizer.

title: Night Shift
description: Log an activity after 8 PM. The Shadow Fern grows best in the moonlight.

title: Premium Taste
description: Preview the Forest Pro theme in Settings. Imagine how lush your garden could look.

title: Streak Master
description: Maintain a 7-day login streak. The Iron Root demands your daily presence.

title: Zen Master
description: Spend 60 seconds in the Game View without tapping anything, just watching the garden breathe (conceptually). Or just score 0 points to relax.

title: The Collector
description: Unlock 5 different plant species in your collection. Biodiversity is key to a healthy ecosystem.
